exercises.question: Which sentence describes change over time?
options: La ciudad ha cambiado mucho en los últimos años. [The city has changed a lot in recent years.]
La ciudad es grande y tiene muchos edificios altos. [The city is large and has many tall buildings.]
La ciudad tiene un museo, un parque y una plaza. [The city has a museum, a park and a square.]

exercises.sentence: Cuando oyó la noticia, mi amiga se __ muy triste.
exercises.english: When she heard the news, my friend became very sad.
Technology has become an important part.

sentences: Al principio, la situación era estable. [At first, the situation was stable.]
Después, la situación se hizo más complicada. [Then the situation became more complicated.]
Finalmente, la situación pasó a ser difícil de controlar. [Finally, the situation became hard to control.]

exercises.question: Which word means «progress»?
options: progreso [progress]
cambio [change]
época [period]

exercises.sentence: La ciudad ha cambiado mucho en los últimos años.
options: The city has changed a lot in recent years.

exercises.sentence: La situación pasó de ser estable a ser más complicada.
options: The situation went from being stable to being more complicated.

The situation became simpler and more stable than before.

exercises.english: Technology has become an important part of everyday life.
